subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

__Only by__ his prudence, he would have incurred a heavy loss.
solution: The correct answer is** 'But for'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined part is grammatically incorrect. • Here,** 'But for'** should be used instead of** 'Only by'.** • **'But for'** is 'used for saying that something would have happened if something else or someone had not prevented it'. • *Example: **But for** your timely warning, we would have been unaware of the danger.* **Correct Sentence:__** ***But for** his prudence, he would have incurred a heavy loss.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • रेखांकित भाग व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है। • यहां **'Only by' **के स्थान पर **'But for'** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • **'But for' **का प्रयोग यह कहने के लिए किया जाता है कि अगर कुछ और होता या किसी ने इसे रोका नहीं होता तो कुछ होता। • *Example: But for your timely warning, we would have been unaware of the danger. * a1:Tae2, The correct answer is **'He did not forgot'.**
